outcome: free drinking water provision in cafeterias
common sources of water (e.g., water fountains)
issues related to water quality (cleanliness, temperature, pressure, taste)
cohort: The study included 96 public schools across four New Jersey school districts.
finding: Most schools (86.5%) reported providing free drinking water in the cafeteria during lunch, predominantly through water fountains, though 20-30% reported issues with water quality.
